artworks.title: The Convalescent (La convalescente)
artworks.medium: etching in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a seated woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to the side, with her head tilted. She has distinct facial features with a calm expression and her hair is mostly hidden under a bonnet tied under her chin. She is wearing a cloak or loose-fitting garment that drapes around her shoulders. Her hand is gently resting in front of her. The background consists of sketched horizontal and vertical lines creating a textured look around her.

artworks.title: The Edge of a Wood at Nohant
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.description: This painting shows a dense forest scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is hidden by green trees and underbrush. Tall trees are visible in the center, sprouting above shorter bushes and ferns.  The undergrowth is dense with low shrubs and grasses, and we can see darker, shadowy sections that lead towards the depths of the forest. The color palette includes deep greens, browns, lighter greens, and ochres, with hints of blue-gray sky at the top beyond the green leaves.

artworks.title: Satyr Leaning on a Column
artworks.medium: black and white chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of the upper body of a person reclining or lying down, facing slightly upwards. The person's head is tilted back, with their eyes closed or looking upward. Their facial features, hair, and body contours are depicted with simple lines. The person appears to be nude, with one arm resting on a surface and the other arm of a different figure in an expressive gesture. The sketch is on textured paper with a plain background, drawn in pencil to emphasize outlines and shading.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion of Polycrates
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure on a cross. The drawing shows various figures surrounding a central figure on a cross, set on rocky terrain. The figures around it are engaged in different activities, with some gesturing upwards and others observing. The background features a detailed rocky and wooded landscape. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style with intricate line work and textural detail.

artworks.title: Apostles Peter and John Healing the Paralytic
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.8 x 42.6 cm (12 1/8 x 16 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a grand architectural setting. The architecture includes columns and arches. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, with some gesturing passionately while others observe. The clothing appears classical. The central focus is a group in the foreground interacting closely. The scene conveys a strong narrative element.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient Roman scene. The image depicts a figure sitting on a throne surrounded by other figures engaged in various activities. In the center, more figures are gathered in front of classical buildings and columns, with a statue atop a pedestal. To the right, figures surround a reclining person on a table, with a winged figure holding a laurel wreath above them. The drawing exhibits intricate line work and hatching typical of classical engravings.

artworks.title: Cavalryman Mounting a Horse
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse and a person in motion. The drawing shows the horse with a flowing mane and a slightly restless posture, along with a tilted head and bent legs indicating movement or agitation. Beside the horse is a figure in a dynamic pose, possibly interacting with or controlling the horse based on their arm and leg positions. The medium is ink on paper, creating a fluid and sketch-like quality, with lines conveying movement and immediacy. The scene captures a moment of action in a minimalistic yet expressive style.

artworks.title: Sacrifice to Priapus
artworks.medium: etching in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.4 x 40.7 cm (10 13/16 x 16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures engaged in a classical scene. The image portrays numerous figures gathered around a central platform with a decorated pedestal or altar and flames. The figures are in various poses, some standing, others seated or reclining, with a sense of movement throughout the composition. Details such as helmets, draped garments, and classical architecture suggest a historical or mythological theme. Objects like shields and vessels can be seen, creating an atmosphere of ritual or ceremony. The drawing has a strong chiaroscuro effect and detailed line work, reminiscent of Renaissance or Baroque art movements.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 29 x 18 cm (11 7/16 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two adults and an infant in a classical style, standing together. The male figure on the left wears ornate armor and the female figure on the right embraces him, holding an infant. The male figure has short hair and strong features, wearing detailed armor and sandals. The female figure has her hair styled back and a relaxed expression, holding the infant who appears content. In the background, there is a cross-hatched design with varying shades, and the floor is patterned.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Two Country Carts and Figures
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a low horizon featuring rolling hills, two birds flying, a figure on a horse-drawn cart with another cart and figure nearby, and a dog walking ahead. Trees are on the left and right sides, with detailed brushstrokes creating textures. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark tree forms contrasting the lighter sky.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: softground etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait capturing the head and shoulders of a person facing forward with a direct gaze. The facial features are depicted with bold strokes, including eyes, a mustache, and a broad face. The hair is dark and somewhat messy. The subject wears a jacket and a shirt with a visible collar, possibly a tie or scarf. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain and light with sketch-like shading for depth. The portrait has a border and a signature at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Convalescent (La convalescente)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in a cushioned chair, with soft facial features and a serene expression. They are wearing a head covering and loose clothing, with one hand resting on their lap holding a ring. The background consists of dense, fine lines.

artworks.title: French Fishing Boats off a Rocky Coast
artworks.medium: watercolor and white gouache over graphite on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 17.5 x 26.5 cm (6 7/8 x 10 7/16 in.)
overall: 27.9 x 35.6 cm (11 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: The painting depicts a scene with boats on the water near rocky cliffs. The horizon is low in the composition, with soft clouds and blue hues dominating the sky. The brushstrokes convey the motion of the water and breeze. Two boats are shown, one with a single occupant and the other with figures, potentially fishing. The scene features a warm palette with tans and ochres on the cliffs, contrasting with the blues and grays of the sky and water. High cliff formations are seen in the distance, with silhouettes of birds in flight.

artworks.title: Studies of Soldiers in Camp
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures in period attire engaged in dynamic poses. The drawing contains figures dressed in historical costumes, portrayed as if involved in a stage play or a narrative scene. The use of fluid and sketchy lines captures movement and action, with an empty background that focuses on the figures.

artworks.title: Three Ladies Chatting
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over graphite
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Mary Kelly Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The sketch shows three individuals standing in a group. The person on the left and the man in the center have their heads turned towards each other. The woman on the left has her hair up, while the man has short hair. The woman on the right is shown with her head tilted down and covered by a hood. All three are dressed in flowing garments. The woman on the right is holding a bag. The woman on the left appears to be gesturing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Marino and the Alban Hills
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash, watercolor, and white gouache over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with rolling hills, a distant building on a hill, a figure in red seated by a house with two cows, and small houses nestled among the hills. The scene is painted in watercolor with a soft color palette of browns, greens, and blues. Trees and expressive brushstrokes add to the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Prophet Addressed by an Angel
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and brown wash above four stylus arcs at bottom right, heightened with white and squared with red chalk on blue paper, laid down on late eighteenth/early nineteenth-century mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image depicts two male figures partially shown at the waist and shoulder respectively. The central figure is seated, slightly leaning to the side, and looking upwards towards the other person. This man's face is in profile with a prominent nose, beard, and a full head of hair. He is dressed in large, flowing garments with detailed folds and appears to be holding an open book or tablet on his lap. The second figure, positioned in the background to the left, is standing and leaning forward, gazing intently at the seated man. This figure's facial features are more obscured, however, he has curly hair and is also dressed in loose-fitting clothing. The surrounding scene and the background are sketch-like with visible grids, suggesting an unfinished or preparatory work, with a textured surface that suggests an atmospheric setting.

artworks.title: An Artist Seated at His Easel [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an artist's space. In the center, a person is seated, working on a canvas on an easel. They wear a loose coat and headwear, with one foot on the ground and the other raised. The surrounding figures, older in appearance, sit nearby. The scene includes various sketched objects and furniture, with a textured paper background. The sketch is created with expressive ink strokes.

artworks.title: A Bellowing Stag
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a stag in a natural setting. The stag has large, branching antlers and is standing on a hilly landscape with sparse vegetation and tall grasses. The drawing is created with fluid ink lines, emphasizing the animal's form and the undulating landscape. Simple lines, shading techniques, and texture are used to depict the scene elegantly and dynamically.

artworks.title: Louis XIII
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays the three-quarters view of a man's upper body. The man is identified as LVDOVICVS XIII CONINCK VAN VRANCRYCK at the bottom of the artwork. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. His face is detailed and expressive, showcasing features like a prominent nose, a pointed mustache, and a small goatee. He has long, wavy hair flowing down past his shoulders. The man is dressed in richly detailed attire with an ornate lace collar and fabric adorned with intricate patterns. He wears a chain with detailed designs around his neck, including fleur-de-lis motifs and crowned initials, along with a large, star-shaped medallion. The background has a delicate, crosshatched texture.

artworks.title: Francois Maynard
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on thin laid paper
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man's head and upper torso within an oval border. The man is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his right, with a calm expression. He has medium-length, wavy hair, distinct facial features, and is dressed in an ornate robe fastened with a decorative clasp. The oval border includes text identifying the individual as "Franciscus Maynardus" and other Latin inscriptions. The background consists of tightly spaced parallel lines.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Unknown Gentleman
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest upwards. The man is facing slightly to his right with a slight smile. He has a prominent mustache and long curly hair. He is wearing a dark robe or cloak over a light-colored, wide-collared shirt. The background is a stone wall pattern and the portrait is framed by an ornate, braided oval frame with ribbon embellishments at the top. Below the portrait frame, there is a decorative architectural element featuring a coat of arms.
